description: Delete a comment on an issue or pull request (by comment id), with its edit history. Its author or a repository writer only. A missing comment is a not-found error, never reported as deleted. Mirrors DELETE /api/v3/repos/:o/:r/issues/comments/:id. Audit-logged (who wrote it, never what it said). Returns {id, kind, number, deleted: true}.

comment_id.description: The comment's id (as listed by gluecron_list_pr_comments, or the #comment-<id> anchor)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_delete_comment
